open_items: ILO: degraded (cycle 1389, direct-path 403 only) -> provider_down (cycle 1390, now also gateway metadata/data 403), confirmed still 403 on live recheck. NOT YET RESOLVED as of this run, unlike every prior occurrence of this pattern which cleared within one cycle. Next run should report whether it recovered or is still down, and flag if provider_down persists past a second consecutive cycle since that would be new.

ECB: healthy -> gateway_issue (cycle 1388, chronic empty 'Error:' on gateway metadata only, direct path unaffected) -> healthy (cycles 1389-1390). Resolved. This is the SECOND ECB incident in close succession (first was cycle 1385-1386, reported last run as breaking a 4-month clean streak); the previous run explicitly flagged that a second incident this soon would be real news. Both incidents trace to the chronic empty-error exception bug, not an ECB-side problem. Worth a maintainer's eye on tools/sdmx_tools.py's generic exception handling given the frequency now.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 161 as of this run (161 last run, unchanged), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. Relevant again next time ILO's periodic-403 pattern shows up as contract-only.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (many occurrences), ESTAT (cycle 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371), ECB (cycle 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, and now 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). Recurred this run on ECB for the second time in one day. Generic exception-handling code, not endpoint-specific. Not fixed by this routine; it only commits to docs/monitor/.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1390. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
UNICEF 404 open item from the previous run (cycle 1386) resolved and stayed healthy through cycles 1387-1390; not recurred. Closed.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time across ABS/FBOS/ILO/SBS/OECD, verdict stays ok as always (ABS flipped again this run).
